title: AI Voice Widget: your digital receptionist – ready 24/7
intro: Our primary solution is the AI Voice Widget – an AI-powered voice assistant that lives directly on your website and handles the customer conversation from the first question to a confirmed booking. The widget can even book a viewing appointment directly through the conversation.

capabilities.title: Answers general questions
capabilities.text: Responds quickly and accurately to customers' general questions about your business, opening hours and services.

capabilities.title: Books and reschedules appointments
capabilities.text: Finds available times and books or reschedules appointments instantly – without customers waiting for a callback.

capabilities.title: Books meetings directly in your calendar
capabilities.text: Books meetings – including viewings – directly in the company calendar, synced in real time.

capabilities.title: Answers questions about products and services
capabilities.text: Gives customers detailed answers about your products and services, so they get the information they need right away.

capabilities.title: Helps webshops with sales and orders
capabilities.text: Supports webshops with sales and order inquiries, so customers get answers while purchase intent is high.

capabilities.title: Answers questions about delivery and orders
capabilities.text: Gives customers status updates and answers to questions about products, delivery and existing orders.

capabilities.title: Guides customers toward a purchase
capabilities.text: Confidently leads customers through the sales process and helps them take the next step toward a purchase.

capabilities.title: Handles inquiries around the clock
capabilities.text: Always available, handling customer inquiries 24 hours a day, 7 days a week – even when the office is closed.

closing: Whatever your industry, the AI Voice Widget is the core of your customer experience – one solution that answers, books and guides your customers all the way.
